description: This file defines the ISC Plugin Bridges module for SmartClient, including class definitions for BrowserPlugin, Applet, Flashlet, SVG, and ActiveXControl, with methods for plugin handling, rendering, and event management.

classes.name: BrowserPlugin
classes.description: Base class for browser plugins, handling drag-and-drop, drawing, and plugin handle management.

classes.name: Applet
classes.description: Class representing Java applet plugins with methods for initialization, drawing, and plugin handle access.

classes.name: Flashlet
classes.description: Class for Flash plugin handling, including version detection and embedding.

classes.name: SVG
classes.description: Class for SVG plugin handling, including registration and native mask management.

classes.name: ActiveXControl
classes.description: Class for ActiveX plugin controls, mainly for IE.

methods.name: handleDragMoveNotify
methods.description: Handles drag move notifications for BrowserPlugin.

methods.name: initWidget
methods.description: Initializes a plugin widget, registers it, and sets up drag mask if needed.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes plugin instances and performs cleanup.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Handles drawing of the plugin, including back mask suppression.

methods.name: getPluginHandle
methods.description: Returns the DOM element handle for the plugin.

methods.name: getInnerHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML string for embedding the plugin.
